name: regkeys
description: Dump a registry key's values and subkeys from a hive with regipy. Text values are decoded, REG_BINARY comes back as hex, and each value says which.

hive.description: Path to the hive file (e.g. work/sf4b205/SOFTWARE)

key.description: Key path inside the hive, e.g. \Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall (empty/omit for root)

recurse.description: Max subkey recursion depth (0 = subkeys only, default 0)

limit.description: Deprecated and refused because it would cut the registry tree; narrow key or recurse instead
